LanguageData.CC_Settings_Convalescence_Tip: After a dangerous illness, a major operation, four days or more laid up in bed, or losing a limb, a colonist is weak for a few days to two weeks: a little slower at work and on their feet, less in bed. They're glad to be alive, or, if they're industrious or a hard worker, weak and frustrated. Friends who sit by the bed lift both their moods. Working while still weak can set the recovery back a couple of days, never more than that. Turned off, none of this starts (the weakness some of Rimfolk's illnesses leave behind stays with the ailments).
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HealerReputations_Tip: Each doctor's patients pulled through (dangerous illnesses and infections, major operations) and lost, and each midwife's births (Biotech), counted in their records and shown on their Story tab. A doctor trusted by the colony puts patients in bed at ease, and others write about them in their journals; a run of losses weighs on the doctor. Names (Goodhands, the Midwife), two life goals and a few dilemmas come from it. Turned off, nothing is counted.
